title: BluemapCreateEntityAddon
description: This bluemap addon displays create entities like windmills or trains and adds support for copycat blocks and train tracks.
body:
This is a BlueMap addon that renders Create contraptions and train tracks on BlueMap. It can also generate train models for **[CreateTrainWebApi](https://modrinth.com/mod/createtrainwebapi)**. To install it, simply place the addon into your BlueMap `packs` folder. For more complete rendering of Create blocks, use it together with: - https://github.com/Uiniel/BlueMapModelLoaders - https://github.com/Uiniel/BlueMap-Create-Resource-Pack ## Contraptions
